class.name: UniversalControllerListItem
class.brief_description: Resource representing a single position in a [TrainUniversalController].
class.description: [UniversalControllerListItem] defines the behavior for a specific position of a train's universal controller. Its index within [member TrainUniversalController.positions] corresponds to the position number (column A) in the [code]UCList[/code] table.

members.member: [code]UCList:H[/code] The position index to which the controller automatically bounces back. Not implemented by the mover as of exe190909, per the wiki.
[code]UCList:G[/code] The rate at which the target value decreases.
[code]UCList:F[/code] The rate at which the target value increases.
[code]UCList:D[/code] The maximum percentage value for this position.
[code]UCList:C[/code] The minimum percentage value for this position.
[code]UCList:J[/code] The nearest stable position index when moving downwards.
[code]UCList:K[/code] The nearest stable position index when moving upwards.
[code]UCList:B[/code] The pneumatic brake position (from the brake pressure table) associated with this universal controller position.
[code]UCList:E[/code] The target percentage value the controller aims to reach at this position.
